facts.why: The plot and transcript never name a Benedetto's. The AFI synopsis puts Charlie and Paulie at Sal's Bar and Restaurant.

facts.text: Bleecker Street, New Year's Eve. This block has always blown its own horn.
facts.why: Nothing in the plot or the transcript puts the film on Bleecker Street or on New Year's Eve. Wikipedia only places it in an Italian neighbourhood of Greenwich Village.
facts.fix: An Italian corner of Greenwich Village. This block has always blown its own horn.

facts.text: for a day at the track with Paulie's racehorse
facts.why: In the transcript Paulie says he owns a piece of a thoroughbred racehorse with two partners, so it is his horse in part.

vibe.verdict: A smart captain's book that uses the staff and the cops well, but it skips the safe job and the lye in the coffee.
